title: ScsActingUnder
description: SCS-CAP-02 "Representative submission" (amendments of 2026-09-27): present only when a PARTY_REPRESENTATIVE submits for another party under a mandate. The same shape in SCS-CAP-02, SCS-CAP-04 and SCS-CAP-05. The link, the mandate and the party the act is for are checked by the capability, which refuses the act on any failure.

representativePartyId.description: The party the actor is linked to (ACTS_FOR_SUBJECT): the mandate's representative party.

mandateId.description: The SCS-CAP-02 mandate from the party the act is for to the representative party.
